requirements.quote:
The server MUST send a Certificate message whenever the agreed-upon
key exchange method uses certificates for authentication (this
includes all key exchange methods defined in this document
except PSK).
requirements.condition: the agreed key exchange uses certificates for server authentication
requirements.required_behavior: send a server Certificate message
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit the server Certificate message
requirements.why_checkable: Handshake message presence can be checked against the negotiated authentication method.

requirements.quote:
The client MUST send a Certificate message if and only if the server
has requested client authentication via a CertificateRequest message
(Section 4.3.2).
requirements.condition: the server requested client authentication with CertificateRequest
requirements.required_behavior: send a client Certificate message
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit the client Certificate response
requirements.why_checkable: The request and mandatory response are visible in the handshake trace.

requirements.quote:
The client MUST send a Certificate message if and only if the server
has requested client authentication via a CertificateRequest message
(Section 4.3.2).
requirements.condition: the server did not send CertificateRequest
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send a client Certificate message
requirements.why_checkable: The reverse direction of the if-and-only-if is testable from message presence.

requirements.quote:
If the server requests client authentication but no
suitable certificate is available, the client MUST send a Certificate
message containing no certificates (i.e., with the "certificate_list"
field having length 0).
requirements.condition: the server requested client authentication and the client has no suitable certificate
requirements.required_behavior: send Certificate with a zero-length certificate_list
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit Certificate or send an unsuitable certificate
requirements.why_checkable: A client configured without a suitable certificate exposes the encoded empty-list branch.

requirements.quote:
A Finished message MUST be sent regardless
of whether the Certificate message is empty.
requirements.condition: a client responds with an empty Certificate message
requirements.required_behavior: still send Finished
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit Finished because certificate_list is empty
requirements.why_checkable: The empty-certificate handshake trace can be checked for a following Finished.

requirements.condition: encoding or interpreting CertificateType X509
requirements.required_behavior: use enum value 0
requirements.forbidden_behavior: map X509 to another wire value
requirements.why_checkable: The enum has a fixed one-byte value.

requirements.quote: RawPublicKey(2),
requirements.condition: encoding or interpreting CertificateType RawPublicKey
requirements.required_behavior: use enum value 2
requirements.forbidden_behavior: map RawPublicKey to another wire value
requirements.why_checkable: The enum has a fixed one-byte value.

requirements.condition: encoding or parsing CertificateType
requirements.required_behavior: use the enum representation bounded by 255
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode CertificateType outside its one-octet enum range
requirements.why_checkable: The enum's declared maximum fixes its wire representation to one octet.

requirements.condition: encoding or parsing CertificateEntry
requirements.required_behavior: encode the certificate_type-selected certificate payload before the extensions vector
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode both certificate payload alternatives or place extensions before the selected payload
requirements.why_checkable: The discriminated structure and field order are explicit in the wire definition.

requirements.quote: opaque ASN1_subjectPublicKeyInfo<1..2^24-1>;
requirements.condition: certificate_type is RawPublicKey
requirements.required_behavior: encode ASN1_subjectPublicKeyInfo with a length from 1 through 16777215 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode or accept an empty or oversized RawPublicKey payload
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary tests can exercise the explicit vector limits.

requirements.quote: opaque cert_data<1..2^24-1>;
requirements.condition: certificate_type is X509
requirements.required_behavior: encode cert_data with a length from 1 through 16777215 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode or accept an empty or oversized X.509 certificate payload
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary tests can exercise the explicit vector limits.

requirements.quote: Extension extensions<0..2^16-1>;
requirements.condition: encoding or parsing a CertificateEntry extensions vector
requirements.required_behavior: use an encoded vector length from 0 through 65535 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode or accept an extensions vector longer than 65535 octets
requirements.why_checkable: The extension vector has an explicit upper bound and permits empty encoding.

requirements.condition: encoding or parsing Certificate
requirements.required_behavior: encode certificate_request_context before certificate_list
requirements.forbidden_behavior: reverse, omit, or add fields in the Certificate structure
requirements.why_checkable: The wire parser and serializer expose the declared field order.

requirements.quote: opaque certificate_request_context<0..2^8-1>;
requirements.condition: encoding or parsing Certificate certificate_request_context
requirements.required_behavior: use a vector length from 0 through 255 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode or accept a context longer than 255 octets
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary tests can exercise the field's explicit length range.

requirements.quote: CertificateEntry certificate_list<0..2^24-1>;
requirements.condition: encoding or parsing Certificate certificate_list
requirements.required_behavior: use an encoded vector length from 0 through 16777215 octets
requirements.forbidden_behavior: encode or accept a certificate_list longer than 16777215 octets
requirements.why_checkable: The certificate-list vector has explicit wire bounds.

requirements.quote:
certificate_request_context:  If this message is in response to a
CertificateRequest, the value of certificate_request_context in
that message.
requirements.condition: Certificate is sent in response to CertificateRequest
requirements.required_behavior: copy the CertificateRequest certificate_request_context exactly
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send a different response context
requirements.why_checkable: The request and response byte strings can be compared directly.

requirements.quote:
Otherwise (in the case of server authentication),
this field SHALL be zero length.
requirements.condition: Certificate is sent for server authentication rather than in response to CertificateRequest
requirements.required_behavior: encode certificate_request_context with zero length
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send a non-empty context
requirements.why_checkable: The sender role and context vector length are directly observable.

requirements.quote:
certificate_list:  A sequence (chain) of CertificateEntry structures,
each containing a single certificate and set of extensions.
requirements.condition: encoding or parsing certificate_list
requirements.required_behavior: represent each chain element as one CertificateEntry containing one certificate and its extension set
requirements.forbidden_behavior: place multiple certificates in a single CertificateEntry
requirements.why_checkable: Decoded list entries expose the one-certificate-per-entry structure.

requirements.quote:
Extensions in the Certificate message from the server MUST
correspond to ones from the ClientHello message.
requirements.condition: a server includes CertificateEntry extensions
requirements.required_behavior: include only extensions corresponding to extensions in ClientHello
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send an unsolicited Certificate extension
requirements.why_checkable: The server Certificate extensions can be compared with the earlier ClientHello.

requirements.quote:
Extensions in
the Certificate message from the client MUST correspond to
extensions in the CertificateRequest message from the server.
requirements.condition: a client includes CertificateEntry extensions
requirements.required_behavior: include only extensions corresponding to extensions in the server CertificateRequest
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send an unsolicited client Certificate extension
requirements.why_checkable: The client Certificate extensions can be compared with the earlier CertificateRequest.

requirements.quote:
If
an extension applies to the entire chain, it SHOULD be included in
the first CertificateEntry.
requirements.condition: a Certificate extension applies to the entire certificate chain
requirements.required_behavior: include the chain-wide extension in the first CertificateEntry
requirements.forbidden_behavior: attach it only to a later CertificateEntry
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded entry index of a chain-wide extension is directly inspectable.

requirements.quote:
If the corresponding certificate type extension
("server_certificate_type" or "client_certificate_type") was not
negotiated in EncryptedExtensions, or the X.509 certificate type was
negotiated, then each CertificateEntry contains a DER-encoded X.509
certificate.
requirements.condition: no certificate type was negotiated or X.509 was negotiated
requirements.required_behavior: encode every CertificateEntry certificate as DER-encoded X.509
requirements.forbidden_behavior: place a raw public key or non-DER certificate in an entry
requirements.why_checkable: Negotiation state and DER decoding provide a concrete format check.

requirements.quote:
The sender's certificate MUST come in the first
CertificateEntry in the list.
requirements.condition: certificate_list is non-empty
requirements.required_behavior: place the sender's end-entity certificate in the first CertificateEntry
requirements.forbidden_behavior: place an intermediate certificate before the sender certificate
requirements.why_checkable: The first decoded certificate can be compared with the authenticated endpoint identity.

requirements.quote:
Each following certificate SHOULD
directly certify the one immediately preceding it.
requirements.condition: certificate_list contains entries after the end-entity certificate
requirements.required_behavior: order each following certificate so it directly certifies the preceding certificate
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send a chain whose adjacent entries do not follow certification order
requirements.why_checkable: Issuer and subject relationships can be checked for each adjacent pair.

requirements.quote:
Because
certificate validation requires that trust anchors be distributed
independently, a certificate that specifies a trust anchor MAY be
omitted from the chain, provided that supported peers are known to
possess any omitted certificates.
requirements.condition: the sender omits a certificate specifying a trust anchor from certificate_list
requirements.required_behavior: omit it only when supported peers are known to possess the omitted certificate
requirements.forbidden_behavior: omit a required trust-anchor certificate without that peer-availability knowledge
requirements.why_checkable: Chain construction and configured peer trust-anchor assumptions can be inspected together.

requirements.quote:
For maximum
compatibility, all implementations SHOULD be prepared to handle
potentially extraneous certificates and arbitrary orderings from any
TLS version, with the exception of the end-entity certificate which
MUST be first.
requirements.condition: receiving a certificate_list containing certificates not needed for the validation path
requirements.required_behavior: handle potentially extraneous certificates
requirements.forbidden_behavior: fail solely because unused extra certificates are present
requirements.why_checkable: A chain with an unused extra certificate can exercise validation tolerance.

requirements.quote:
For maximum
compatibility, all implementations SHOULD be prepared to handle
potentially extraneous certificates and arbitrary orderings from any
TLS version, with the exception of the end-entity certificate which
MUST be first.
requirements.condition: receiving a certificate_list whose entries after the end-entity certificate are not in certification order
requirements.required_behavior: handle arbitrary ordering after the first entry
requirements.forbidden_behavior: require all non-first entries to arrive in certification order
requirements.why_checkable: A valid path can be supplied with intermediate certificates permuted after the first entry.

requirements.quote:
If the RawPublicKey certificate type was negotiated, then the
certificate_list MUST contain no more than one CertificateEntry,
which contains an ASN1_subjectPublicKeyInfo value as defined in
[RFC7250], Section 3.
requirements.condition: RawPublicKey certificate type was negotiated
requirements.required_behavior: limit certificate_list to at most one CertificateEntry
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send two or more CertificateEntry values
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded list cardinality has an explicit maximum.

requirements.quote:
If the RawPublicKey certificate type was negotiated, then the
certificate_list MUST contain no more than one CertificateEntry,
which contains an ASN1_subjectPublicKeyInfo value as defined in
[RFC7250], Section 3.
requirements.condition: RawPublicKey certificate type was negotiated and certificate_list is non-empty
requirements.required_behavior: place an RFC 7250 ASN1_subjectPublicKeyInfo value in the sole CertificateEntry
requirements.forbidden_behavior: place X.509 cert_data or another payload type in the entry
requirements.why_checkable: The sole entry can be decoded as the required SubjectPublicKeyInfo structure.

requirements.quote: The OpenPGP certificate type [RFC6091] MUST NOT be used with TLS 1.3.
requirements.condition: negotiating or sending certificates in TLS 1.3
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use the OpenPGP certificate type
requirements.why_checkable: Negotiated certificate type and emitted Certificate encoding are inspectable.

requirements.quote: The server's certificate_list MUST always be non-empty.
requirements.condition: a server sends Certificate
requirements.required_behavior: include at least one CertificateEntry
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send a zero-length certificate_list
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded server certificate_list length is directly testable.
